author: Assistant session at the owner's request (M10 completion, 2026-11-19/20); owner acceptance pending through the review of PR #24
reason: The protocol preregistered runs R1-R4, oracles, faults N1-N10 and gate A-H, but the run driver, the 7B end-to-end equivalence, the 14B full-coverage parity, the per-mode fault probe and the gate with BLOCKED did not exist (PREPARATION_INCREMENT_10 section 6, limit 5). This amendment pins them.

Timing, stated plainly: the tools were written during the campaign session of 2026-11-19/20 and are pinned after the runs. Thresholds, workload, start/abort criteria and verdict rules are the frozen ones of protocol.json and are read from it or duplicated as constants and checked against it by tests; no criterion was widened.

Corrections made during the campaign, each with its failed evidence kept: (1) the M9 fault probe injects at read 100, which on the 14B falls inside layer-0 q_proj before any K/V write, so the probe check "candidate bank was modified" failed (F-sync attempt 1); tools/fault10.py places the fault midway through layer-0 o_proj (the structural point of M9 on the 7B) and keeps the check unchanged; (2) the gate reused the gate-9 forward checks that assume captures in every run, while the protocol has captures for R1 only; digest-only runs get explicit replacement checks; (3) campaign10 records are written through sanitize9.portable (two earlier O7 records sanitized after writing, digests kept).

Run mapping of the frozen abort actions inside tools/campaign10.RUN_POLICY: pause-and-annotate and the I/O-attribution criterion are annotations, kill-scope-invalidate-run kills the run scope only (cgroup.kill), the acquisition stop action is an annotation for runs.

invariants.note: only new tools are pinned (from null); no previously pinned tool changes

not_verifiable_on_runner.skip_message: local unsanitized originals are not on this machine
not_verifiable_on_runner.cause: tests/test_increment9_hardening.py "-real" cases need the local unsanitized M9 originals, which are deliberately not in Git (sanitization of increment 9)

ci_runner_verification.rule: runner verdict PASS = every runner-verifiable required test passed, nothing missing, extra or duplicated, and each declared test either passed or was skipped with exactly the declared message; such a skip is NOT VERIFIABLE ON RUNNER and keeps the full-inventory verdict of the runner at NOT PROVEN. The archived local attestation must be a full PASS of the same inventory with its pinned JUnit SHA256. CI succeeds only if both hold.
